title.narrative: Technical support to State Governments, a core programming strategy has yielded significant and multidimensional results. For instance, In Assam, UNICEF evaluated 148 SDRF projects worth US$ 41.01 million, approving 46 projects totaling US$ 17.72 million- a 15% increase in fund utilization over 2023. Successful utilization of SDRF funds in Andhra Pradesh included USD 9M for preparedness and capacity building, USD 105M for mitigation projects, and cash transfers to 72,479 flood-affected families. Flagship program of School Safety saw expansion from grade 2-12th grade in Bihar whereas in Chhattisgarh secured half a million dollars from Education department benefiting 3.1 million children.
